statistic: nearest-rank p95 RSS (MB) per group; transcript groups use one value per logical run (its peak over every follow-up)
gate: a group fails when its p95 exceeds its baseline by more than 10%; a hard 150 MB ceiling applies to every single invocation regardless

derivation.hosted-linux: median of the per-run group p95 across the retained main runs 9986fe6, e287ecf, 1b3ed5d, 85768a5 (#224), d927292 and 9aac257 (GitHub ubuntu-24.04). drain: median of its single sample across the same runs.
derivation.hosted-macos: median of the per-run group p95 across the same retained main runs on GitHub macos-latest (macOS transcript StopBurst has 3 complete runs).
derivation.dgx02: median of the group p95 across 3 unconstrained (no taskset) remote_dev verify runs at main 9aac257 on dgx02, 2026-11-02. Unconstrained, because CI also runs unconstrained; taskset runs characterize contention, not the steady baseline. A dgx02 run must set AMEM_RUNNER=dgx02 to be judged against these.
derivation.full-spool: measure-full-spool-budget is not run by the hosted check, so only dgx02 carries full-spool baselines; a hosted run of it would need one recorded first.

change: baselines change only through a PR that links the evidence runs for the new values (#228 owner decision 2026-11-02)

hosted-linux.full-spool:*: not gated: not run in CI

hosted-macos.full-spool:*: not gated: not run in CI
